verses.text: Icha tik ix aj stz'ib'chajkan masanil heb' israel t'a stzolal tas yaj yinhtilal heb' b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel. Ha heb' anima ay t'a Judá, ik'chajnakb'at heb' t'a Babilonia yuj schukal.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Israel b'ab'laj meltzajxikot t'a sluum yet' t'a schonhab', haton heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.
Ha t'a Jerusalén ix kan kajan heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yik Benjamín, heb' yik Efraín yet' heb' yik Manasés.

Ha t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 690 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá, a winhaj Utai yuninal winhaj Amihud yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' smam yicham t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Omri, winhaj Imri, winhaj Bani yet' winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá chi'. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá chi', a winhaj Asaías winh b'ab'el unin, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' sk'ab'yok. Axo t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Zera, yuninal pax winhaj Judá chi', a winhaj Jeuel yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín tik: Winhaj Salú yuninal winhaj Mesulam yixchikin winhaj Hodabías, yinhtilal winhaj Asenúa, winhaj Ibneías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ela yixchikin winhaj Uzi, yinhtilal winhaj Mikri, winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Sefatías, yixchikin winhaj Reuel, yinhtilal winhaj Ibnías. 956 heb' t'a smasanil.

Axo heb' winh sakerdote kajan t'a Jerusalén yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok: Haton winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jaquín yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Azarías t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Meraiot yet' winhaj Ahitob. Ha winhaj Azarías chi' yajal t'a stemplo Dios. Anheja' t'a skal heb' winh yajal yaj chi', ayoch winhaj Adaías yuninal winhaj Jeroham. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winhaj Adaías chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Pasur, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Masai, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jahzera, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Mesilemit yet' winhaj Imer. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ay mil 760 heb' winh te nhikan smunlaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' lewita kajan t'a Jerusalén: Haton winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Hasub, yixchikin winhaj Azricam, schab'il yixchikin winhaj Hasabías, yinhtilal winhaj Merari.
Yajal pax winhaj Bakbakar, winhaj Heres, winhaj Galal yet' winhaj Matanías yuninal winhaj Micaía, yixchikin winhaj Zicri, yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.

Yajal pax yaj winhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Semaías, yixchikin winhaj Galal, yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Berequías, yuninal winhaj Asa, yixchikin winhaj Elcana ek'nak kajan t'a juntzanh aldea yik heb' netofatita.
Axo heb' winh stanhwan puerta: Haton winhaj Salum, winhaj Acub, winhaj Talmón, winhaj Ahimán yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh. Ha winhaj Salum yajal yaj t'a heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh tik stanhwannhej puerta yik heb' winh rey t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haton heb' winh stanhwan puerta chi' t'a skal heb' yetlewitail.

Ha winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Coré, yixchikin winhaj Ebiasaf, yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, a heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios, icha ajnak stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios chi' heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Ha t'a peka' chi', a winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar ayoch yajalilok heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios chi'. Aynhej wal och Jehová yet' winh.
Axo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Meselemías, a winh stanhwan spuertail b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios.

Ha sb'isul heb' stanhwan spuertail kajnub' sik'b'ilel chi', 212 heb' tz'ib'ab'ilkani icha tas yinhtilal junjun makan b'aj kajan heb'. Ha winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios ak'jinakkanoch heb' t'a yopisio niwan yelk'och chi'.
Masanil heb' yet' pax yuninal heb', ayoch heb' t'a stzolal stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios.
Aynhejoch stanhwumal chi' t'a schanhil pak'anh: T'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a stojolal norte yet' t'a stojolal sur.
Ha heb' yetlewitail heb' kajan t'a juntzanhxo aldea, t'a junjun yuktakil k'ual sjawi heb' stanhwej templo chi', yik skolwaj heb' yet' heb'.
Ay chanhwanh heb' lewita niwak yopisio stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha heb' chi' ayoch heb' t'a masanil tiempo stanhwan juntzanh kuarto yet' b'aj smolchaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ha heb' chi' aynhejek' heb' t'a spatiktak kajnub' chi' tzek' ak'wal, yujto a heb' stanhwani. Axo t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil sjakan kajnub' chi' heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' t'a skal heb' chi' stanhwan juntzanh yamk'ab' sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal t'a Dios. Yowalil sb'is heb' jantak tz'elta, slajwi chi' sb'isan heb' yochxikani.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' tz'ilan juntzanhxo yamk'ab' niwak yelk'ochi yet' pax ixim harina, wino, akeite, inkienso yet' perfume.
Ay pax heb' sakerdote sb'oan perfume chi'.
Axo jun winh lewita skuchan Matatías, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Salum, yinhtilal winhaj Coré, a winh sb'oan ixim pan tz'ak'ji ofrendail.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetlewitail heb' winh, heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Koat, a heb' winh sb'oan ixim pan tz'em tzolan t'a sat mexa t'a yol skajnub' Dios t'a junjun k'ual ik'oj ip.

Anhejtona' ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal heb' winh lewita chi' sb'itani. Ha t'a juntzanh kuarto yik templo chi' ay heb' winh, malaj yalan yik heb' winh t'a juntzanhxo munlajel, yujto k'ual t'ak'wal yajoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi'.
Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha yaj stzolal yinhtilal heb' winh. Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan heb' winh.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón, ata' ek'nak kajan winhaj Jehiel, smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Miklot.
Ha winhaj Miklot chi' smam winhaj Simeam. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis chi' smam winhaj Saúl. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ha winhaj Jonatán chi' smam winhaj Merib-baal smam winhaj Micaía.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Haton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melek, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.

Axo winhaj Acaz smam winhaj Jara. Axo winhaj Jara chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmavet yet' winhaj Zimri. Axo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa. Axo winhaj Mosa chi' smam winhaj Bina. Axo winhaj Bina chi' smam winhaj Refaías, winhaj Elasa yet' winhaj Azel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Azel chi', wakwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Azricam, winhaj Bokru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías yet' winhaj Hanán.
